children: Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, said on Sunday it had net outflows of about $3.64 billion between 0600 and 1530 GMT on November 1 after a resumption of withdrawals.
The outflows represented 2.1% of Binance's total $171 billion in assets under management, it said in a post on X.

Binance said it had processed over $4.64 billion in withdrawals and $1.01 billion in deposits during the period. It stressed, however, that "withdrawal volumes have declined and are stabilising as expected, while deposit volumes have remained substantial."
